messages:
Alex: Heads-up — Product wants a way to share runtime dashboards with customers. Need alignment on RBAC, what metrics are safe to expose, and audit requirements. :eyes:
Priya: +1. Customers keep asking for token-level cost estimates and latency SLAs in the console. We should map expectations: aggregated vs raw.
Casey: Agree. From runtime side we can emit both aggregated and request-level streams, but exposing request-level is a hard no (prompts contain customer data).
Javier: Security note: anything that could include prompt text or request IDs that map back to content must be blocked or redacted. We also need an immutable audit trail for "share" events and role changes.
Morgan: For ML metrics, we can provide per-model aggregated stats and sample-based quality metrics. But sampling must be opt-in and scrubbed.
Sam: UX question: do we add a "Share view with customer" toggle on each dashboard? How do we represent internal vs customer variants?
Alex: Proposed semantics: internal view = full metrics + request logs; customer view = aggregated metrics only, no raw requests, no traces that include input. Sharing action should create a record: who, when, scope, TTL.
Priya: Product prefers lightweight sharing: customer gets a link + ability to pin to their workspace. Need expiration and owner controls. Auditability required for compliance customers.
Casey: Implementation idea: backend endpoint POST /internal/shares to create a share object. Serving infra will check role at query time. Customer-facing endpoints will only return fields white-listed for "customer" role.
Javier: Make sure we store share events in the audit log service with write-once semantics. Also log downstream access attempts (who viewed the shared link). Retention: 7 years for enterprise customers? We should confirm with legal.
Morgan: About metrics: suggest exposing these to customers (aggregated): avg_latency_ms, p50/p95/p99, successful_requests, error_rate_pct, tokens_generated, est_cost_usd. Not exposing: raw_prompts, request_id, kv_cache_contents, user_id.
Alex: Quick sample whitelist for customer-facing API:
```
allowed_fields: [
  "avg_latency_ms",
  "p50_latency_ms",
  "p95_latency_ms",
  "p99_latency_ms",
  "successful_requests",
  "error_rate_pct",
  "tokens_generated",
  "est_cost_usd"
]
```
Priya: Also need role matrix: internal-admin, internal-viewer, customer-admin (customer can invite team), customer-viewer. Customers shouldn't be able to toggle redaction or sampling.
Casey: We'll enforce role checks in the query layer. For performance, we can compute customer views as materialized aggregates (precomputed) to avoid heavy queries. That avoids leaking by timing attacks.
Sam: Console UX: show a clear "Customer view" preview toggle. When creating a share show a modal: scope (entire dashboard vs single chart), TTL (1d/7d/never), allowed viewers (customer-team emails), and an audit checkbox that we will log viewer events.
Javier: Add required consent language for sampling. Also add a flag to prevent sharing for customers flagged under strict compliance profiles.
Priya: Rollout plan: feature-flag the UI and API, pilot with 3 customers for 2 weeks. Collect metrics on usage + support tickets.
Casey: Dev tasks: (1) share API + DB table, (2) query-gating by role, (3) precompute customer aggregates, (4) telemetry hooks for view events.
Morgan: ML tasks: define sanitized sampling pipeline, add sampling opt-in and review of samples prior to including them in any shared view.
Javier: Security tasks: audit log ingestion, access retention policy, KV encryption for share metadata, and policy-checker for compliance-blocked customers.
Alex: Ops/deploy: add new IAM roles and map existing org roles to them. We'll need migration script. Sam, can you mock the modal copy?
Sam: Yep, I'll draft copy + a wire. Will post in #design later today. :art:
Priya: Owners: eng-platform (Casey + Alex) feature lead, product (Priya) PM, security (Javier) compliance. Target: gated internal beta in 3 weeks.
Casey: One more question — telemetry volume. If we precompute aggregates per-customer, we might blow up the metrics cardinality. Suggest storing per-customer hourly aggregates only for shared dashboards.
Alex: Good point. Keep retention short by default (30d) and make longer retention opt-in/paid. Note to billing team.
deploy-bot: Deployment started: dashboard-sharing-service v0.1 -> staging.
Javier: Action: I'll prepare a short security checklist and send to @Priya and @Casey.
Casey: I'll carve out sprint capacity and open an RFC with proposed schema and endpoints.
Priya: Thanks everyone. Quick action items we agree on: create share API, whitelist fields for customer views, audit log on create/view, UI modal + TTL, feature flag + pilot.
Alex: I'll follow up with an RFC link and schedule a 30-min sync with the group tomorrow. :calendar:
Sam: Adding a checklist to the thread after wire is up.
Morgan: Adding ML-sampling doc link once ready.
Priya: Closing the loop — this feels actionable. :thumbsup:
